subject: prd/implement-now
statement: While working a recognized e2e task, the executor's deliverable shall be the automated test the scenario names — or, for the harness slot, the harness that scenario tasks depend on — exercising behavior the feature has already built, and the executor shall not implement or alter the behavior under test in order to make the scenario pass.
rationale: an e2e task proves existing behavior; a worker that changes that behavior to reach green has destroyed the only thing the test was for
fit_criterion: a fixture whose scenario fails against genuinely-broken feature behavior yields a failing test and an escalated task, never a feature edit that makes it pass; a proposal altering behavior under test outside the charter's stated scope is reported under UB-16 and never counted succeeded
